 Yes, affordable housing still exists! In this video, we tour a real $100,000 home in Killeen, Texas, with a mortgage payment of only $1,000 a month. If you are a first-time home buyer looking for cheap homes in Texas, Killeen is one of the last markets in the country where this is possible.

 In today’s housing market, finding a home under $200k feels impossible, let alone $100k. But in Central Texas, specifically the Killeen / Fort Cavazos area, the dream of homeownership is still alive.

In this video, I break down:

Full tour of a move-in ready home listed at $100,000.


Why Killeen, TX real estate is so affordable compared to Austin or Dallas.

The reality of buying a budget home: Is it a fixer-upper or a gem?

If you are tired of renting and want to build equity, this tour will show you exactly what your money gets you in the 2026 Texas housing market.
